# The Foundational Ratios

## #0 — The standing identity

The two directed readings of `0/1` give the musical account its starting whole. `0/1` reads ground towards expression; `1/0` reads the achieved expression towards its condition. In the standing identity, their joint presence is written:

$$
\frac01+\frac10=\frac11\equiv100\%.
$$

The signs here retain their native QL offices. The plus gathers the two traversals; `1/1` names the whole recognised through them. Ordinary division by zero supplies no numerical value for the second term. The identity states the relation which the following finite arithmetic will articulate, rather than a sum evaluated in the ordinary real-number field.

[Binary Explication, File 4, “The Foundational Ratios”](../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-binary-explication/taylor-2026-binary-explication.md) **sources** this musical return. Definition has earned the conscious circumstance; process has traversed its relations; quilting has reconstituted their meaning. Music receives their ratio-body. The [core-theorems spine, §I](../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md) **derives** the curated kernel: native QL accounting generates proportions which can be worked as exact intervals.

## #1 — The whole accounts for its components

Second Spanda reckons the achieved whole on a hundred-unit scale. The binary principle taken through six positions gives `2⁶=64`; the sixfold taken through its second-order accounting gives `6²=36`. Together:

$$
100=64+36=2^6+6^2.
$$

The whole is `100%`, or one whole; `100` is its chosen accounting scale. Comparing the two components performs a further operation:

$$
\frac{64}{36}
=\frac{64/4}{36/4}
=\frac{16}{9}
=\frac{2^4}{3^2}
=\left(\frac43\right)^2.
$$

The shared factor four is removed from numerator and denominator. The sum remains one hundred while the proportion becomes sixteen to nine. The prime-factor reading then retains four binary factors above and two ternary factors below. QL reads their distinct offices as **4:2**, the four explicate relations and two implicate poles of the sixfold. Reading the same ratio as a squared fourth will give the musical span its two successive passes.

[A15, Ratio and the Account](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A15-Ratio-Rationality-Measure-Reckoning-Harmony-Account.md) **defines** the distinction between this partition and this comparison. The account becomes exact by keeping the change of operation visible.

## #2 — The cross-comparison gives direction

The other reading of the sixfold is **3:3**. Its primary subject-operation follows first-, second- and third-person perspectives with three acts of recognition: voiding their isolation, recognising their unity, and returning that one as `0/1`. The second triad therefore performs one recognition, making the same passage **3:1**. [AM/IS](../../AM-IS.md) **grounds** this personed movement before its musical rendering.

QL cross-compares `4:2` with `3:3` by matching their components:

$$
(4,2)\ \text{against}\ (3,3)
\quad\longmapsto\quad
\left(\frac43,\frac23\right).
$$

This is the declared cross-comparison of two readings, followed by finite fraction operations. Reciprocation gives `3/4` and `3/2`. In frequency-ratio space, a ratio states the resulting frequency divided by the starting frequency. The four directions are consequently exact:

| Ratio | Interval | QL direction |
|---|---|---|
| `4/3` | Ascending perfect fourth | Manifestation |
| `3/4` | Descending perfect fourth | Recognition |
| `3/2` | Ascending perfect fifth | Aspiration |
| `2/3` | Descending perfect fifth | Grounding |

Successive intervals multiply. If the first changes frequency by `r` and the second by `s`, their combined ratio is `rs`. Thus fourth and fifth compose the octave:

$$
\frac43\cdot\frac32=\frac{12}{6}=\frac21.
$$

The same fourth taken twice gives `16/9`. Its resulting frequency is below the octave; the next calculation determines the interval still required.

## #3 — Three convergent derivations of the epogdoon

The **epogdoon**, `9/8`, is the whole-tone ratio required here. File 4 supplies three routes to it. Each division compares intervals multiplicatively:

$$
\text{Octave over totality:}\qquad
\frac{2/1}{16/9}=2\cdot\frac9{16}=\frac98.
$$

$$
\text{Fifth over fourth:}\qquad
\frac{3/2}{4/3}=\frac32\cdot\frac34=\frac98.
$$

$$
\text{Doubled sixfold-square over binary field:}\qquad
\frac{2\cdot6^2}{2^6}=\frac{72}{64}=\frac98.
$$

The third is the octave/totality calculation expressed through the original counts: `2÷(64/36)=72/64`. Their convergence exhibits one invariant through the interval and counting readings.

The load-bearing return follows:

$$
\boxed{\frac{16}{9}\cdot\frac98=\frac{144}{72}=\frac21.}
$$

For a starting frequency of `240 Hz`, the doubled fourth reaches `1280/3 Hz`. Multiplying that frequency by `9/8` reaches `480 Hz`, exactly the octave of the starting frequency. The ratio between the two arrivals is `9/8`; their additive frequency difference is `160/3 Hz`. These are different measures of the same specified passage.

## #4 — The complete canonical set

The operations have now earned all eight ratios:

$$
\boxed{\left\{\frac11,\frac43,\frac34,\frac32,
\frac23,\frac{16}{9},\frac98,\frac21\right\}.}
$$

`1/1` retains the starting frequency; fourths and fifths give the four directed spans; `16/9` gives the doubled fourth; `9/8` supplies its interval to octave; `2/1` gives the achieved doubling. Placing the whole-tone between the two fourths makes the same return available as the tetrachord relation:

$$
\frac43\cdot\frac98\cdot\frac43=\frac21.
$$

The [musical-v3 source house](../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-ql-musical-derivation-v3/taylor-2026-ql-musical-derivation-v3.md) **sources** the parallel development. This record projects the exact kernel retained by the curated spine. File 4 and v3 are superseded in practice by the actual ql-mef package; its current implementation has not been recovered for this projection. That source-locality debt concerns current implementation details, while the printed ratio operations remain fully checkable here.

Pure ratios also keep their own object apart from a twelve-tone equal-tempered pitch-class projection. Six pure `9/8` steps give `531441/262144`, which exceeds `2`; they do not close an octave. An equal-tempered whole tone uses `2^(1/6)` and closes after six steps. The ratio kernel therefore reaches its octave through the worked fourth–whole-tone–fourth relation, preserving the difference that a chromatic projection must account for under its own tuning rule.

## #5→0 — The ratio returns through its difference

[§3 · #4, Topology and Musical Resolution](../../../section-rooms/04-mathematical-substrate/movements/29-s3-p4-topology-music-resolution.md) **embodies** the essay consequence: the totality reaches octave return through the `9/8` interval. Removing that factor would leave `16/9`, so the difference performs completion. [A16](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A16-Arche-Topos-as-Differential-Field.md) **extends** this retained difference into the coordinated differential field. An interval and a topological opening retain their different mathematical operations within that argued coordination.

Music carries the full processually earned chain:

$$
\frac01=4+2=(5\rightarrow0)=\frac10
=4'+2'=(5'\rightarrow0')=\frac01.
$$

In this process reading, the primes name the inverse-phase positions. File 3 also uses primes for the Night-pass sequence, the Power face; that is a distinct indexing office. The full musical circuit retains both traversals. The shorter definitional chain belongs to the 0-side vantage carried by definition and quilt.

The record **returns-to** [A17](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A17-Toroidal-Circulation-and-the-Arche-Topos.md), which distinguishes another cycle of performance from recognition of the standing relation that performance enacts. The interval can lead into another passage; the player can also recognise the relation and come to silence. The exact octave is achieved through retained difference, and the achieved relation returns to the conscious circumstance from which its reckoning began.
